$comment: RAG chatbot — ingestion dashboard (NFR-8, implementation.md 5.6). Grafana-format, PostgreSQL datasource. Queries verified against the real schema: documents(state, byte_size, uploaded_at, indexed_at, error_reason) and chunks(chunk_id, doc_id, token_count, created_at). Note chunk_count is NOT a documents column — it lives on chunks, so chunk counts are joined rather than read off documents.
title: RAG — Ingestion

panels.$comment: The Document.state distribution is the single most useful ingestion panel: 'failed' and 'duplicate' accumulating while 'live' stays flat means the pipeline stopped converting documents, and nothing else on this dashboard would show it as loudly.
panels.title: Documents by state
panels.description: Lifecycle state per architecture.md 4.1. Only 'live' is retrievable — everything else is invisible to search.

targets.rawSql: SELECT state, count(*) AS documents FROM documents GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY documents DESC
SELECT count(*) AS live FROM documents WHERE state = 'live'

panels.$comment: Failure rate over time. A sustained rise points at the extraction sandbox (resource caps, OOM-kills) or the embedding provider, and it is the ingestion-side counterpart to the query-path alerts.
panels.title: Ingest failure rate
panels.description: Share of documents landing in 'failed' per hour.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(uploaded_at, '1h'), avg(CASE WHEN state = 'failed' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS failure_rate FROM documents WHERE $__timeFilter(uploaded_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Documents indexed per hour
panels.description: Count and total bytes of documents reaching 'live', by index time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(indexed_at, '1h'), count(*) AS documents FROM documents WHERE $__timeFilter(indexed_at) AND indexed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Bytes ingested per hour
panels.description: Volume in, which is what actually drives extraction, chunking, and embedding cost.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(indexed_at, '1h'), sum(byte_size) AS bytes FROM documents WHERE $__timeFilter(indexed_at) AND indexed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.$comment: Upload-to-indexed latency, in seconds. This is the number a user waiting on a large upload actually experiences, and it spans sandbox extraction, chunking, embedding, and index write — so a regression here localises only once the stages below are read.
panels.title: Ingest latency: upload → live (s)
panels.description: Time from upload to indexed_at, per document.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(uploaded_at, '1h'), percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (indexed_at - uploaded_at))) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (indexed_at - uploaded_at))) AS p95 FROM documents WHERE $__timeFilter(uploaded_at) AND indexed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Chunks created per hour
panels.description: Chunk yield. A drop in chunks-per-byte usually means the chunker stopped splitting, which quietly shrinks retrieval context and degrades answer quality without any error.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(c.created_at, '1h'), count(*) AS chunks FROM chunks c JOIN documents d ON d.doc_id = c.doc_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Mean tokens per chunk
panels.description: Chunk sizing. Drifts when the chunker config changes; very large values risk exceeding the context budget at retrieval time.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1h'), avg(token_count) AS mean_tokens FROM chunks WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Most recent failures
panels.description: error_reason is the sandbox/extraction failure text. Grouped failures here usually name a single systemic cause (memory cap, unsupported MIME type, locked file).

targets.rawSql: SELECT uploaded_at, filename, mime_type, state, error_reason FROM documents WHERE state = 'failed' ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC LIMIT 25
